item.title: AACPS Graduation Rate Rises for Second Straight Year
item.description: Anne Arundel County Public Schools saw its overall graduation rate rise for the second consecutive year, data released by the Maryland State Department of Education shows.

item.title: A Rare Annapolis Retreat Where Sunrise and Sunset Water Views Frame Everyday Life
item.description: This exquisite Savannah-style custom home is perfectly positioned in the sought-after Fishing Creek Farm community, offering rare dual water views from nearly every room.

item.title: "Momentum: A Mixed Bill" Will Bring You Powerful Movement, Emotion, and Meaning
item.description: Ballet Theatre of Maryland’s "Momentum: A Mixed Bill" invites audiences to settle in and experience ballet in a way that feels fresh, expressive, and deeply human.

item.title: African American History Museums and Sites
item.description: The Chesapeake region is home to a remarkable concentration of museums, landmarks, and cultural sites that illuminate the richness and resilience of African American history.

item.title: Valentine's Day Gift Guide 2026
item.description: Make your Valentine's Day shopping even more special this year with unique gifts only found at our local businesses!

item.title: Annapolis' Annual Greenscape Event Set for April 25
item.description: Annapolis Mayor Jarod Littmann invites residents of the City of Annapolis to join in the effort to beautify Maryland’s Capital City by participating in GreenScape 2026, set for Saturday, April 25.

item.title: Chamber Announces Leadership Transition Honoring Outgoing President & CEO and Appointing Amy Berry as Successor
item.description: The Anne Arundel County Chamber of Commerce today announced a leadership transition, marking the departure of President & CEO Mark Kleinschmidt after seven years of dedicated service, and the promotion of Amy Berry to President & CEO.

item.title: Rotary Club of Annapolis Awards Grants from Crab Feast Proceeds
item.description: Each summer, the Rotary Club of Annapolis holds its Crab Feast, which is a major annual fundraiser with all proceeds donated to local charities and non-profit organizations.

item.title: Rotary Club of Annapolis Is Accepting Scholarships
item.description: The Rotary Club of Annapolis, an organization of business, civic, and professional community leaders, is offering academic scholarships to graduating seniors attending local high schools.
